purpose: estimator comparison on the identical locked-point administered sets
rationale: LOCKED to MWLE (user decision, consistent with Bridge/BiGGen). MLE has the nominally-closest slope (0.945) but is REJECTED: it has the WORST correlation (r=0.89 vs MWLE 0.957) and the WORST theta-MAE (0.512 vs MWLE 0.428) because plain MLE diverges on all-pass/all-fail administrations (unbounded theta), inflating variance. MWLE's Warm penalty keeps it finite and robust, giving the best r and MAE while only slightly shrinking the slope (0.890). MWLE is the deployment instrument; all four estimators are reported.
